subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should OpenClaw change exec-like tool-error and lastToolError fallback policy so a failed read-only tool with no user-visible reply produces a warning or incomplete-turn fallback?
rationale: Current main intentionally suppresses some exec-like warnings and all lastToolError incomplete-turn fallbacks, while the issue asks to surface them when no reply was delivered; that is a user-visible terminal-turn policy choice.

options.title: Adopt the no-reply exception
options.body: Allow warnings or fallback only when no user-facing reply was delivered and payloadCount is zero, preserving existing suppression when the assistant already replied.

options.title: Keep current suppression
options.body: Leave exec-like and lastToolError suppression unchanged and treat the remaining request as expected behavior after the placeholder fix.

options.title: Split follow-up issues
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and track placeholder, warning policy, and incomplete-turn quarantine with separate canonical reports.

recommendation.title: Adopt the no-reply exception
recommendation.body: Allow warnings or fallback only when no user-facing reply was delivered and payloadCount is zero, preserving existing suppression when the assistant already replied.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged empty post-tool final-turn recovery work is the closest current owner signal for the fallback contract this decision would change.
